# HttpProtectOptions.redis property

An existing ioredis client to use instead of opening another connection.

**Signature:**

```typescript
redis?: Redis;
```

## Remarks

Pass this if your application already has a client. Supplying it also prevents the constructor from connecting on its own, which is the only way to construct a [HttpProtect](/api/http-protect/latest/http-protect.httpprotect/) without immediately opening a socket. Note that [HttpProtect.destroy()](/api/http-protect/latest/http-protect.httpprotect.destroy/) disconnects whichever client it is holding, including one passed in here.
